notes.title: Secrets of Bullets in the Space
notes.notes:
[h1]Have you got any gold keys? How many spaceships have you managed to unlock? Have you already unlocked the Secret Mode? And the secret spaceships?[/h1]

Be the first to share your achievements, post your best moves, capture the funniest moments, and spread the word in the Bullets in the Space community.

Post screenshot, art and videos of gameplays in the community and we will share in the official page of the UBAG in facebook/twitter;

https://www.facebook.com/ubartstudios/

https://twitter.com/UBArtStudios

UB Art Games.

notes.title: The release has arrived!!!
notes.notes:
[h1]Bullets in the Space[/h1]

Finally came this long awaited date for us here at [i]UB Art Games[/i], the launch of our first game on [i]Steam[/i].

It is a very important goal that has been achieved, however, it is just the beginning of a great dream to be trodden!

We thank all players, regardless of playing our game, because it was thinking of you that [b]Bullets in the Space[/b] became reality...

I hope you enjoy the experience and can share your moments and help us improve the development in future titles, where our intention is to make our games bigger and better.

Thank you all! ːsteamhappyː

UB Art Games

notes.title: Bullets in the Space - Official release date!
notes.notes:
It is with great joy ːsteamhappyː that we, from UB Art Games, announce the official release date of [i]Bullets in the Space[/i], which will be available on 08/03/2018.

We devote many hours of development to make [i]Bullets in the Space[/i] enjoyable and fun for all ages without losing the challenging spirit and sense of accomplishment.

We hope you enjoy and provide us with the feedback you need to build new and better games as well as new updates for this game.

Thank you all!
